  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pvinverter/Ac/Power")
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "grid/Ac/Power")

  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)

  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "battery/Soc")
  |> last()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

consL1 = from(bucket: "venus")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system/Ac/Consumption/L1/Power")
  |> last()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

consL2 = from(bucket: "venus")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system/Ac/Consumption/L2/Power")
  |> last()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

consL3 = from(bucket: "venus")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system/Ac/Consumption/L3/Power")
  |> last()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

pv   = if exists pvRecord._value then pvRecord._value else 0.0
grid = if exists gridRecord._value then gridRecord._value else 0.0
bat  = if exists batRecord._value then -batRecord._value else 0.0
batSoc = if exists batSocRecord._value then batSocRecord._value else 0.0
house_load = (if exists consL1._value then consL1._value else 0.0) +
             (if exists consL2._value then consL2._value else 0.0) +
             (if exists consL3._value then consL3._value else 0.0)

array.from(rows: [
  {pv: pv, load: house_load, "battery/Dc/0/Power": bat, "battery/Soc": batSoc, "grid/Ac/Power": grid},

import "array"
import "math"

// === DANE PRZYKŁADOWE ===
// pv   = 1800.00 // (produkcja pv)
// grid = -1000.00 // (import grid, dla export są wartości ujemne)
// bat  = 0.0 // (ładowanie baterii, dla rozładowywania są wartości ujemne)
// house_load = 800.00   // z L1+L2+L3

// Pobieranie danych
pv1Record = from(bucket: "venus")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pvinverter/Ac/Power" and r.instanceNumber == "20")
  |> last()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

pv2Record = from(bucket: "venus")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pvinverter/Ac/Power" and r.instanceNumber == "21")
  |> last()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

gridRecord = from(bucket: "venus")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "grid/Ac/Power")
  |> last()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

batRecord = from(bucket: "venus")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "battery/Dc/0/Power")
  |> last()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

consL1 = from(bucket: "venus")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system/Ac/Consumption/L1/Power")
  |> last()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

consL2 = from(bucket: "venus")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system/Ac/Consumption/L2/Power")
  |> last()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

consL3 = from(bucket: "venus")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system/Ac/Consumption/L3/Power")
  |> last()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

pv1   = if exists pv1Record._value then pv1Record._value else 0.0
pv2   = if exists pv2Record._value then pv2Record._value else 0.0
pv = pv1 + pv2

grid = if exists gridRecord._value then gridRecord._value else 0.0
bat  = if exists batRecord._value  then batRecord._value  else 0.0

house_load = (if exists consL1._value then consL1._value else 0.0) +
             (if exists consL2._value then consL2._value else 0.0) +
             (if exists consL3._value then consL3._value else 0.0)

// Wartości bezwzględne
pv_prod       = if pv > 0.0 then pv else 0.0
grid_import   = if grid > 0.0 then grid else 0.0
grid_export   = if grid < 0.0 then math.abs(x: grid) else 0.0
bat_charge    = if bat > 0.0 then bat else 0.0
bat_discharge = if bat < 0.0 then math.abs(x: bat) else 0.0

pv_to_house = if pv_prod < (house_load - grid_import) then pv_prod else house_load - grid_import
pv_to_battery = bat_charge

pv_to_grid = if grid_export > 0.0 then
               (pv_prod - pv_to_house - pv_to_battery)
             else 0.0

// Udział produkcji każdego falownika
pv1_ratio =
    if pv_prod > 0.0 then pv1 / pv_prod else 0.0

pv2_ratio =
    if pv_prod > 0.0 then pv2 / pv_prod else 0.0

// Rozdzielenie przepływów
pv1_to_house = pv_to_house * pv1_ratio
pv2_to_house = pv_to_house * pv2_ratio

pv1_to_battery = pv_to_battery * pv1_ratio
pv2_to_battery = pv_to_battery * pv2_ratio

pv1_to_grid = pv_to_grid * pv1_ratio
pv2_to_grid = pv_to_grid * pv2_ratio

// Reszta domu
battery_to_house = bat_discharge

grid_to_house = grid_import

local_flow = array.from(rows: [
  // PV1
  {pv: "PV", source: "PV Inverter 1", victron: "Victron", target: "House",   value: pv1_to_house},
  {pv: "PV", source: "PV Inverter 1", victron: "Victron", target: "Battery", value: pv1_to_battery},
  {pv: "PV", source: "PV Inverter 1", victron: "Victron", target: "Grid",    value: pv1_to_grid},

  // PV2
  {pv: "PV", source: "PV Inverter 2", victron: "Victron", target: "House",   value: pv2_to_house},
  {pv: "PV", source: "PV Inverter 2", victron: "Victron", target: "Battery", value: pv2_to_battery},
  {pv: "PV", source: "PV Inverter 2", victron: "Victron", target: "Grid",    value: pv2_to_grid},

  // Pozostałe przepływy
  {pv: "Battery", source: "Battery", victron: "Victron", target: "House", value: battery_to_house},
  {pv: "Grid",    source: "Grid",    victron: "Victron", target: "House", value: grid_to_house},
])
|> filter(fn: (r) => r.value > 0.0)

debug = array.from(rows: [
  {name: "RAW_PV",          value: pv},
  {name: "RAW_GRID",        value: grid},
  {name: "RAW_BAT",         value: bat},
  {name: "HOUSE_LOAD",      value: house_load},
  {name: "PV_PROD",         value: pv_prod},
  {name: "GRID_IMPORT",     value: grid_import},
  {name: "GRID_EXPORT",     value: grid_export},
  {name: "BAT_CHARGE",      value: bat_charge},
  {name: "BAT_DISCHARGE",   value: bat_discharge},
  {name: "PV_to_House",     value: pv_to_house},
  {name: "PV_to_Battery",   value: pv_to_battery},
  {name: "PV_to_Grid",      value: pv_to_grid},
  {name: "Battery_to_House",value: battery_to_house},
  {name: "Grid_to_House",   value: grid_to_house},
])

sample_sankey = array.from(rows: [

])
